symptom: On Customers, clicking Refresh (or any background refetch) makes the table stutter: every row re-renders even when the refreshed page returns exactly the same customers.

truth.cause: CustomersTable derives its columns array with CUSTOMER_COLUMNS.filter(...) on every render and passes it to the memoised CustomerRow, so each render gives every row a new columns identity and memo never bails out.

referenceFix.replace:
import { useMemo } from 'react'
import type { Customer } from '../../api/types'
